name: Joah
title: Descendant of Simeon
summary: Joah (also known as Jakin) was a son of Simeon, who was one of Jacob's twelve sons. He is mentioned in the genealogies as one of the founders of a clan within the tribe of Simeon. His significance lies primarily in his role as the patriarch of one of the families in Israel's tribal structure.

keyEvents.title: Born as a son of Simeon
keyEvents.description: Joah was born as one of Simeon's sons, and thus became part of Jacob's extended family and Israel's tribal structure.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy in Exodus
keyEvents.description: Joka is listed among the sons of Simeon in the genealogy describing the families of the children of Israel in Egypt.

keyEvents.title: Recorded in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Joka is mentioned in the genealogical records in 1 Chronicles as part of Simeon's descendants, where his name appears as Jarib.

keyEvents.title: Jacob's family travels to Egypt
keyEvents.description: As part of Jacob's extended family, Joka was among those who went down to Egypt during the famine, laying the foundation for Israel's stay there.

keyEvents.title: Part of the tribe of Simeon in the people of Israel
keyEvents.description: Joka and his descendants formed one of the clans within the tribe of Simeon, which later became part of the Israelite community.
